meta.caseTitle: The Case of the Shattered Pickaxe

suspects.name: Silas
suspects.personality: Gruff, resentful, and prone to outbursts.
suspects.physicalDescription: Burly build, calloused hands, with a weathered face and a perpetual scowl. Wears sturdy mining gear.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was in the victim's workshop, murdering Terran.
suspects.claimedAlibi: Was out mining for ore in the Crystal Caves all night.
suspects.trueMotive: Jealousy and financial ruin; believed the victim stole his mining claims.
suspects.lyingTells: Becomes defensive and agitated when questioned about his whereabouts.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: Knows Elara is a skilled alchemist and suspects she might have seen something, but believes she is too timid to talk. He also knows of the rivalry between Terran and the other miners.

suspects.name: Elara
suspects.physicalDescription: Slight frame, with bright, curious eyes and often stained fingers from alchemical experiments. Wears practical, if slightly singed, robes.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was in her laboratory, heard a commotion, saw Silas fleeing.
suspects.claimedAlibi: Was in her laboratory, experimenting with new potions. Heard nothing.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: She witnessed Silas fleeing the scene but is afraid to testify against him.
suspects.lyingTells: Avoids eye contact, speaks in hushed tones, and fidgets nervously.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: Knows Silas has a volatile temper and a history of disputes with Terran. She also knows that the victim was experimenting with volatile reagents.

suspects.name: Grom
suspects.physicalDescription: Massive, muscular build, with a booming voice and soot-stained apron. His hands are as large as dinner plates.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was working late in his forge, repairing mining equipment. Can provide witnesses from the nearby tavern.
suspects.claimedAlibi: Was working late in my forge, repairing mining equipment. I heard the commotion but thought it was just another mining accident.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: Knows Silas has been increasingly bitter about Terran's success. He also knows Elara is a bit eccentric but harmless.

suspects.name: Lyra
suspects.physicalDescription: Elegant, with sharp features and an expensive, well-maintained outfit. Carries herself with an air of authority.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was in her shop, closing accounts. She saw Terran earlier that day discussing a rare gem.
suspects.claimedAlibi: I was in my shop, closing accounts. Terran owed me a considerable sum for supplies.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: Knows Silas is deeply in debt and has been arguing with Terran. She also knows Elara has been trying to acquire rare alchemical ingredients.
